theater: 西奈半島與蘇伊士運河走廊

battle.name: 第二次中東戰爭
battle.theater: 西奈半島與蘇伊士運河走廊
battle.brief: 一九五六年十月二十九日以色列進攻西奈，三十一日英法空襲埃及機場，蘇伊士運河危機全面化。卡面這件一八五〇年的德國線膛野戰砲此時已屬館藏，塞得港與蘇伊士交火的是其直系後代：二十五磅砲、一〇五毫米野戰砲與一二〇毫米迫擊砲。十一月五日英法空降塞得港，七日蘇伊士陷落，停火止於拉法。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰方是三方聯盟對一國。以色列方面在戰前已完成大規模動員，國防軍參謀長摩西·馬克萊夫中將主持全軍，總參謀部摩西·達揚少將負責作戰計畫，總理大衛·班·古里安坐鎮特拉維夫；地面部隊以裝甲師、步兵師與傘兵旅為骨幹，另有工兵、通信與勤務部隊，南方戰線由裝甲旅與第二〇二傘兵旅擔任，空軍由莫爾代凱·霍德指揮。埃及方面由總統迦梅爾·阿卜杜勒·納賽爾掌握全局，陸軍參謀長阿卜杜勒·哈菲茲·穆罕默德統率作戰部隊，蘇伊士運河兩岸與西奈沙漠由第四裝甲師及數個步兵師駐守，工兵在運河上築起堵塞工事，海軍退守塞得港與蘇伊士外海，運河沿線的護航任務自十月起中止。英國與法國組成聯合部隊：英國由首相安東尼·艾德禮與國防大臣鄧肯·桑迪斯拍板，出動皇家海軍東地中海艦隊、空軍中東部隊，以及以傘兵為主的突擊部隊，自塞浦路斯與馬耳他起飛登陸；法國由總理摩里斯·庫瓦·德·默維爾與外長埃德加·福爾主導，派出第二突擊團與從阿爾及利亞調來的傘兵團參與。停火之後，聯合國維持和平部隊進駐運河區，監督以軍與英法部隊撤退。
countriesEn: The belligerents were a three-sided coalition against a single state. On the Israeli side a large-scale mobilisation had already been completed before the war: Major General Mordechai Maklef presided over the army as Chief of Staff, Major General Moshe Dayan was responsible for operational planning in the General Staff, and Prime Minister David Ben-Gurion stayed in Tel Aviv; the ground forces were built on armoured and infantry divisions and a parachute brigade, with engineer, signal and service units, the southern front being held by an armoured brigade and the 202nd Paratroop Brigade, and the air force commanded by Mordechai Hod. On the Egyptian side President Gamal Abdel Nasser held the whole situation in his hands, with the Chief of Staff Abdel Hafez Mohamed commanding the operational forces; the Fourth Armoured Division and several infantry divisions garrisoned the Suez Canal bank and the Sinai desert, engineers built obstructions across the canal, and the navy withdrew to the open sea off Port Said and Suez, while canal convoys were suspended from October. Britain and France formed a combined force: in Britain the decision to intervene was taken by Prime Minister Anthony Eden and Defence Secretary Duncan Sandys, committing the Royal Navy's Eastern Mediterranean fleet, the Middle East air force and a commando force built around paratroopers, flying from Cyprus and Malta; in France the initiative was taken by Prime Minister Maurice Couve de Murville and Foreign Minister Edgar Faure, with the 2nd Commando and a parachute regiment brought from Algeria. After the ceasefire the United Nations Emergency Force entered the canal area to supervise the withdrawal of the Israeli and the Anglo-French troops.
people: 關鍵人物集中在三地。埃及方面，納賽爾是整場危機的樞紐：他在一九五六年九月二十六日宣布將蘇伊士運河公司收歸國有，十月二日以封鎖運河回應英法壓力，以軍越境後又拒絕任何停火談判，堅持主權與榮譽不可交易，把蘇伊士變成全國性的政治議題。以色列方面，代號「卡德什」的全盤作戰計畫出自總參謀部，把全軍分成四路縱隊同時穿插；第二〇二傘兵旅旅長拉斐爾·伊坦指揮夜襲馬格達巴，第七裝甲旅旅長海姆·巴爾-列夫指揮正面強攻艾布-阿基拉，他日後主持運河東岸的防線工程，那條防線因他得名。英法方面，真正推動出兵的是英國首相艾德禮，他頂住內閣與黨內的反對，最終讓政府以數票之微過關，但三個月後仍因這場戰爭辭職；法國由庫瓦·德·默維爾與福爾主導，理由是不能讓運河落入埃及控制之下，否則通往阿爾及利亞的補給線無從保障。聯合國軍第一批部隊則由加拿大籍的伯恩斯中將率領，進駐運河兩岸。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities sit in three capitals. In Egypt, Nasser was the pivot of the entire crisis: on 26 September 1956 he announced the nationalisation of the Suez Canal Company, on 2 October he answered British and French pressure by closing the canal, and after the Israeli crossing he refused any ceasefire negotiation, holding that sovereignty and honour were not tradable, which turned Suez into a national political issue. On the Israeli side the master plan for the campaign, code-named Kadesh, came out of the General Staff and split the whole army into four parallel thrusts; Brigadier General Rafael Eitan commanded the night attack on Magdhaba with the 202nd Paratroop Brigade, and Brigadier General Haim Bar-Lev commanded the frontal assault on Abu-Ageila, later taking charge of the works on the eastern bank of the canal, which was named after him. On the British and French side the man who pushed the war was British Prime Minister Eden, who stood against his own cabinet and his own party, saw the government survive by a handful of votes, and yet resigned over the war three months later; in France Couve de Murville and Faure took the lead, on the argument that the canal could not be allowed to fall into Egyptian control, since the supply line to Algeria would then be impossible to secure. The first United Nations contingent was led by the Canadian General Burns on the two banks of the canal.
kits: 卡面上這件一八五〇年的德國線膛野戰砲，到一九五六年已經退到博物館與軍械庫的架子上：普魯士在一八五〇年代裝備的六磅線膛砲，早被一八七〇年代以後的後裝砲取代，它在這場戰役裡的位置，只可能由同一條血脈的後代來接。真正在蘇伊士運河走廊交火的正是這些後代。英軍野戰砲兵以二十五磅砲為骨幹，另有五·五吋榴彈砲與一二〇毫米迫擊砲；法軍為一〇五毫米野戰砲與一五五毫米榴彈砲；以軍同樣以二十五磅砲、一二〇毫米及一五五毫米為主。埃及軍以蘇聯製七六毫米野戰砲與一二二毫米榴彈砲為骨幹，後方還留著一批戰前購入的舊式野戰砲與海岸重砲。卡面兵器的直系後裔在德國那邊反而活得比英法更久：一〇五毫米一六式野戰砲在聯邦德國與法國一直服役到一九六〇年代，七·五公分野戰砲更是一九六〇年才裝備部隊，用到一九九〇年代仍未退役。線膛帶來的射程優勢，正是這條血脈延續百年的緣由。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card, a German rifled muzzle-loading field gun of 1850, had by 1956 been pushed back onto the shelves of museums and depots: the six-pounder rifled gun with which Prussia equipped its artillery in the 1850s had long been superseded by breech-loading guns after the 1870s, so in this campaign its place could only be taken by the descendants of the same line. And it was exactly those descendants that fought along the Suez Canal. British field artillery was built around the 25-pounder, with 5.5-inch howitzers and 120mm mortars; the French used the 105mm field gun and the 155mm howitzer; the Israelis likewise relied on 25-pounders, 120mm and 155mm pieces. The Egyptian army relied on Soviet 76mm field guns and 122mm howitzers, with batches of older field guns and heavy coastal pieces bought before the war still held in the rear. The direct descendant of the card's weapon actually outlived Britain and France in Germany: the 105mm leFH 16 stayed in service with the Bundeswehr and in France into the 1960s, and the 7.5cm field gun was not even issued to troops until 1960 and remained in use into the 1990s without being retired. The range advantage that rifling brought is the reason this line of descent lasted a century.
tactics: 以色列的戰術是一次沿縱深平行的多路突進：南部由第二〇二傘兵旅夜襲馬格達巴口岸得手，中部以重裝甲突入艾布-阿基拉封鎖線，奪取「拉烏特的花」觀測所，並在「中國農莊」一役摧毀埃及第四裝甲師，北部由裝甲部隊插入拉法與沙姆沙伊赫之間的缺口，十一月一日至二日再以渡河作戰強渡烏姆赫基爾涸谷向縱深推進。各路都刻意用夜襲與清晨奇襲，配空軍制空與傘兵空投，節奏極快，使埃及軍指揮部連續失去戰場態勢。英法介入後，埃及軍的攻勢在十月三十一日被空中打斷：英法空軍對埃及各機場大規模空襲，摧毀其空軍主力與前線航空力量，配合名為「藍色多瑙河」的通訊欺瞞，使開羅相信以軍主力正轉向運河，埃及裝甲部隊因此被釘在原地。十一月五日至六日，英法以傘兵與突擊部隊在塞得港空降，法軍先占機場與南端市區，英軍第三突擊團與皇家海軍陸戰隊第四十五突擊團隨後進入市區北半，控制港口與運河北端；運河南端由另一支部隊登陸占領蘇伊士市。補給全靠海運自馬耳他與塞浦路斯送入，艦隊以航母與運兵船維持固定班次，淡水則靠伊士美利耶甜水渠把尼羅河水送入運河，沖淡海水的倒灌。
tacticsEn: Israeli tactics were a set of parallel thrusts deep into the enemy's rear. In the south the 202nd Paratroop Brigade won the night attack on the Magdhaba crossing; in the centre heavy armour broke through the Abu-Ageila blocking line, took the Bnei Re'ut observation post and destroyed the Egyptian Fourth Armoured Division at the Chinese Farm; in the north armoured forces drove a wedge between Rafah and Sharm el-Sheikh, and on 1 and 2 November an operation crossed the Wadi Um Khheir and pushed into the depth. All of them deliberately worked by night attack and dawn surprise, with air supremacy and parachute drops, moving fast enough that the Egyptian command lost the picture of the battlefield again and again. Once Britain and France intervened, the Egyptian advance was broken in the air on 31 October: a large air strike by the Anglo-French air forces against Egyptian aerodromes destroyed the Egyptian air force and the forward aviation effort, and a communications deception called Blue Danube convinced Cairo that the main Israeli force was turning towards the canal, pinning the Egyptian armoured units where they were. On 5 and 6 November British and French paratroopers and commandos dropped on Port Said: the French took the aerodrome and the southern part of the town first, and the British 3rd Commando and the Royal Marines' 45th Commando followed into the northern half, taking the port and the northern end of the canal; at the southern end another force landed and occupied the city of Suez. Supply came entirely by sea from Malta and Cyprus, the fleet keeping up a fixed shuttle service with carriers and troopships, and fresh water reached the canal through the Ismailia sweet-water canal, which carried Nile water forward to check the salt water pushing in from the Mediterranean.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰役自一九五六年十月二十九日以軍越境至十一月七日英法接受停火，主要戰鬥歷時約十天，以軍投入的地面部隊約三萬五千至四萬五千人，埃及軍在運河以東的部隊約三萬人上下。英法空軍在最初的空襲中出動逾一千五百架次，以色列空軍同日出動數百架次；以軍方面宣稱首日十二個機場的空襲摧毀埃及軍機四百五十架，這個數字出自交戰方公佈，未經獨立核實。傷亡方面，以軍陣亡人數常見引述為四十餘人、受傷約一百六十餘人，英法聯軍陣亡在數十人量級，埃軍陣亡與被俘的統計口徑分歧較大，多落在數千人上下。運河全長約一百六十四公里，危機前承擔全球一成多的貿易與進入歐洲的海灣石油運輸；封閉後約六十餘艘船滯留大苦湖，國籍分屬英、荷、法、以、埃等國；一九五七年三月清理完竣後重新通航。聯合國軍首批約六千至九千人，經安理會五六七號、五六九號與五七一號決議授權進駐。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The campaign ran from the Israeli crossing on 29 October 1956 to the Anglo-French acceptance of the ceasefire on 7 November, the main fighting lasting about ten days; the Israeli ground commitment was about 35,000 to 45,000 men, and the Egyptian force east of the canal something like 30,000. The Anglo-French air forces flew more than 1,500 sorties in the opening strike, while the Israeli Air Force flew several hundred on the same day; the Israeli claim that the first-day raids on twelve aerodromes destroyed 450 Egyptian aircraft comes from the belligerent itself and has not been independently verified. On casualties, Israeli dead are commonly given as a little over forty with some 165 wounded, Anglo-French dead in the tens, and the Egyptian count of dead and captured varies by source, generally falling in the low thousands. The canal is about 164 kilometres long and before the crisis carried a little over a tenth of world trade and much of the Gulf oil moving towards Europe; after the closure some sixty-odd ships were stranded in the Great Bitter Lake under British, Dutch, French, Israeli and Egyptian flags, and the passage was cleared and reopened to traffic in March 1957. The first United Nations force numbered about 6,000 to 9,000 men, entering under Security Council resolutions 567, 569 and 571.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接起因是運河公司收歸國有與運河封鎖。一九五四年《英埃協議》規定英軍自蘇伊士基地逐步撤出，一九五六年九月二十六日開羅宣布將蘇伊士運河公司收歸國有，並組織專門委員會接管其資產，英國視之為對協議的背叛；十月二日埃及封閉運河，理由是運河公司人員仍與英國海軍共用基地設施。深層原因是英法在能源與戰略通道上的焦慮：英國在一九五〇年代高度依賴中東石油，運河是通向歐洲的咽喉，航運安排一旦由埃及主導便成隱患；法國則要保住通往阿爾及利亞的補給生命線，一九五四年開打並逐漸升級的阿爾及利亞戰爭使這條線路格外敏感。國際層面上，一九五六年十月二十九日美、英、法發表三方聲明，堅持一九五四年協議並要求運河重開，同日以色列進兵西奈，把英法的軍事介入變成兩個目標合一的行動。蘇伊士也帶來冷戰格局的意外收穫：莫斯科作出強硬姿態，華盛頓卻發現自己無法為盟友承擔第三次世界大戰的風險。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the war was the nationalisation of the canal company and the closure of the canal. The 1954 Anglo-Egyptian agreement had provided for the phased withdrawal of British troops from the Suez base; on 26 September 1956 Cairo announced the nationalisation of the Suez Canal Company and set up a commission to take over its assets, which Britain read as a betrayal of the agreement, and on 2 October Egypt closed the canal on the ground that company personnel were still sharing base installations with the Royal Navy. The deeper cause was the Anglo-French anxiety over energy and strategic chokepoints: in the 1950s Britain depended heavily on Middle Eastern oil, the canal was the throat through which it reached Europe, and once the routing of shipping was in Egyptian hands it became a standing risk; France needed to keep the supply artery to Algeria alive, and the Algerian war, begun in 1954 and gradually escalating, made that line acutely sensitive. At the international level, on 29 October 1956 the United States, Britain and France issued a tripartite declaration standing on the 1954 agreement and demanding the reopening of the canal, and the same day Israel entered Sinai, turning British and French military intervention into a single action serving two objectives. Suez also brought an unexpected windfall from the Cold War: Moscow adopted a hard line, while Washington discovered that it could not carry the risk of a third world war on behalf of an ally.
impact: 蘇伊士的後果遠超出中東本身。英國在政治上被削去一頂超級大國的冠冕：一九五六年十一月艾德禮在電視講話中承認英國不會單方面對埃及動武，內閣以數票之微勉強過關，翌年一月艾德禮辭職；美國停止以國際收支名義向英國供應石油，英鎊隨後承受拋售壓力，一九五七年三月匯價由二·八美元下調至二·四美元。軍事上，這場戰役第一次把制空權、傘兵與突擊部隊的組合、艦載機對地攻擊與海上補給的整條鏈條同時擺在一個戰區裡，一九五七年英國陸軍以「未來軍隊」文件確立空運與突擊為戰役骨幹並成立傘兵團，垂直機動作戰的想法由此進入各國陸軍的作戰條例；美軍同年修改空地協同手冊，通信兵則用了一次「藍色多瑙河」式的欺瞞作戰。戰略層面的教訓最為直接：兩個超級大國可以在同一個戰區各自支持盟友，也能各自把盟友拉回來，開羅最後靠的是聯合國，而不是武器。埃及的收穫是運河與正當性，軍隊雖在戰場上被壓制卻沒有崩潰，並在之後數年獲得大批蘇制新裝備。
impactEn: The consequences of Suez reached far beyond the Middle East. Britain was politically stripped of a superpower's crown: in November 1956 Eden conceded on television that Britain would not take unilateral military action against Egypt, the government survived by a handful of votes, and in January of the following year Eden resigned; the United States stopped supplying Britain with oil under the international payments arrangement, the pound came under selling pressure, and in March 1957 its rate was cut from 2.80 to 2.40 US dollars. Militarily, this was the first campaign to put the whole chain — air supremacy, parachute and commando landings, carrier-borne attack and seaborne supply — into a single theatre at once; in 1957 the British Army's Future of the Army paper made air movement and shock action the backbone of the battle and created the Parachute Regiment, and vertical manoeuvre entered the doctrine of armies across the world, while the United States revised its air-ground cooperation manual and the signal corps produced a deception operation in the manner of Blue Danube. The strategic lesson was the most direct of all: the two superpowers could each support an ally in the same theatre, and each could also pull its own ally back, and what finally restored the canal to Cairo was the United Nations rather than weapons. Egypt gained the canal and legitimacy; its army was beaten in the field but did not collapse, and it received large quantities of new Soviet equipment in the years that followed.
result: 結果是一場沒有贏家、卻人人有所收穫的收場。英法聯軍占領塞得港與蘇伊士之後，在美國施壓與蘇聯恫嚇下同意停火：一九五六年十一月七日埃及接受停火，以軍推進至拉法外圍，翌日占領拉法與阿里什；撤退自一九五七年一月開始，以軍至三月二十二日完成撤出，英軍於四月初、法軍於四月上旬先後離開運河區，聯合國維持和平部隊留駐兩岸直至一九六七年。以色列退回一九五六年停戰線，保有加薩地帶與沙姆沙伊赫；埃及保住運河主權，卻要長期面對以色列沿運河東岸修築的巴爾-列夫防線，運河於一九五七年三月重新通航。埃及軍隊損失了第四裝甲師等精銳，卻沒有崩潰，戰後反而加速換裝；英國以失去運河為代價，換來了一九八二年福克蘭群島那場收復戰爭——那才是英國海外用兵的最後一次大規模行動。
resultEn: The result was a finish in which nobody won outright but everybody kept something. Having occupied Port Said and Suez, the Anglo-French forces agreed to a ceasefire under American pressure and Soviet threats: on 7 November 1956 Egypt accepted the ceasefire, the Israeli advance reached the approaches to Rafah, and the next day Rafah and El-Arish were taken. The withdrawal began in January 1957, the Israelis completing theirs by 22 March, with the British leaving the canal area in early April and the French a few days later, while the United Nations Emergency Force stayed on both banks until 1967. Israel fell back to the 1956 armistice line, keeping the Gaza Strip and Sharm el-Sheikh; Egypt kept sovereignty over the canal, though it then had to live for years with the Bar-Lev line built by Israel along the eastern bank, and the canal reopened to traffic in March 1957. The Egyptian army lost the Fourth Armoured Division and other fine formations, but it did not break, and it actually accelerated its re-equipment after the war; Britain paid for the loss of the canal, and what it bought in return was the 1982 campaign to retake the Falklands, the last large-scale overseas operation of British arms.
